title: Zebra holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M64 38 Q62 50 58 62' stroke='#c0c0d0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='24' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='20' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='66,36 63,38 69,38' fill='#cc2222'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#cc2222'/>

  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='62' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Zebra body stripes -->
  <path d='M28 54 Q32 58 30 62' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 50 Q38 56 36 62' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 49 Q46 57 44 64' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 50 Q54 57 52 64' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='50' y='70' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='68' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Leg stripes -->
  <rect x='28' y='74' width='6' height='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <rect x='40' y='74' width='6' height='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <rect x='50' y='74' width='6' height='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='6' height='3' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='84' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='84' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>

  <!-- Front legs (holding balloon side) -->
  <rect x='54' y='66' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#d8d8e8' transform='rotate(-15 56 66)'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='46' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <path d='M12 40 Q16 44 14 48' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 38 Q20 43 18 48' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 38 Q28 43 26 48' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='50' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f0d0d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='10' cy='49' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#5a3a3a'/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='20.8' cy='42.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='35' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-20 16 35)'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='34' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(15 26 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='35' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#f0a0a0' transform='rotate(-20 16 35)'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='34' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#f0a0a0' transform='rotate(15 26 34)'/>

  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M14 37 Q32 30 40 44' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M64 58 Q72 54 74 62' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='63' r='2.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M10 52 Q12 54 14 53' stroke='#5a3a3a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
